ns2:section.sectionText: AL1 Lecture must be added with an 'AD_' Discussion Section. ***RESTRICTED TO ECON (LAS) MAJORS until August 21st (restriction will be lifted by noon). ACTUARIAL SCIENCE majors will be able to register starting April 24th. Approved DUAL-DEGREE Econ students should contact econug@illinois.edu for major overrides. Students who have COMPLETED THE CRITERIA AND WILL BE DECLARING ECON may apply for overrides once grades have posted by completing the following form between 5/20/17-6/5/17: http://go.economics.illinois.edu/CourseOverrides. OTHER MAJORS NEEDING ECON ADVANCED COURSES must wait until the restriction is lifted- or should contact their departmental academic advisor to check on other available options, or have their office contact the Economics Department directly (econug@illinois.edu). EXCHANGE STUDENTS SHOULD CONTACT OUR OFFICE (econug@illinois.edu) to request an override (pending capacity)- PRIORITY WILL BE GIVEN TO ECON/LAS EXCHANGE STUDENTS and others pre-approved.
